projects.title: CS ED Week's Hour of Code: Grasshopper's Filter a Photo Activity
projects.description:
Grasshopper is a self-study coding education environment where students can progress at their own pace with limited direction needed from an instructor. 

Grasshopper’s Filter a Photo allows students to learn the mechanism of how image filtering works and create their own filters using JavaScript. The Grasshopper platform uses a custom editor environment where students can focus on coding real JavaScript without having to worry about syntax problems.

This activity is great for beginner coders in grades 9+ and teaches variables, conditionals, loops, functions and event listeners.
